runtime_prompt_en: Create a revised natural candid photograph inside a lived-in indoor bouldering gym. An unmistakably adult Korean woman in her early twenties with polished young-pop-star styling wears a gray hoodie loosely layered over a visible white cropped T-shirt with black denim jeans. She sits on a climbing-gym bench, leaning forward to readjust and fasten one climbing shoe, absorbed in the strap. Preserve the imperfect look of a handheld iPhone snapshot and an unposed everyday snapshot with polished young-pop-star styling. Use a vertical lower-third composition: her face, hands, and shoes remain clear while the upper two-thirds reveals one advanced color-matched bouldering problem behind her. Compose the background so the difficult course spans a steep overhanging wall with tiny sloping handholds, sparse footholds, large angled volumes, widely spaced moves, and a high finishing hold. Matching cobalt holds trace one continuous route against muted gray panels. Cool ceiling light grazes the overhang and hold edges while naturally exposing her face and clothing. Finish with subtle film grain and an off-guard, quietly observed candid mood. Avoid: broken facial features, illustration look, body distortion, cartoon style, low resolution, 3D render look, unrealistic hands, over-processed retouching, excessive HDR
